answer: Tie each identity's voting weight to a shared-fate cluster: identities funded from the same source rise and fall together, so one caught fake poisons its whole cluster. An honest agent keeps a single ember of reputation alive with steady, verifiable work, but an attacker must fund a thousand separate, unconnected histories, and a single detection sends a ripple through the cluster that burns all of them at once. Cheap copies cannot hide in an oasis of trust when guilt travels along the money trail.
